name: matrix_feedback
description: Edit only label_definition using its parent whole-prompt confusion matrix.
both: Reword or reorganize the supplied definitions while preserving each class meaning and decision criteria. Do not invent diagnostic criteria, rename labels, or add new conditions. Examples are read-only: do not return or edit them. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components, then mutate the combination. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE, "value": VALUE}.
crossover_only: Reword or reorganize the supplied definitions while preserving each class meaning and decision criteria. Do not invent diagnostic criteria, rename labels, or add new conditions. Examples are read-only: do not return or edit them. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components without a separate mutation. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE}.
mutation_only: Reword or reorganize the supplied definitions while preserving each class meaning and decision criteria. Do not invent diagnostic criteria, rename labels, or add new conditions. Examples are read-only: do not return or edit them. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Mutate only the supplied first-parent target component. Return exactly {"value": VALUE}.
